content.text: We ship pan-India via trusted courier partners. Standard orders are delivered in 3–6 business days after printing; if yours arrives later because of a delay on our side, you can return it for a full refund. Orders of ₹1,999 or more ship free — all other orders carry a flat ₹99 shipping fee, shown at checkout.
Most products go to print within 24–48 hours of order confirmation. Custom or bulk orders may take longer — if yours will, we'll email you.

Because most Aaraprint products are made to order, we can't accept returns for a change of mind. If your order arrives damaged or doesn't match your approved design, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we'll reprint it free, or refund you if a reprint doesn't fix it.
